personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT paired with 1 iOS-Native Clean structure
personality_one_liner: Calm, trustworthy, highly structured foundation and emergency response app combining editorial elegance with robust operational clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, consistent card and container margins with touch targets >= 44pt

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers over scrolling content
Apply translucent surface overlays on bottom-sheet headers and hero cards
dont's: Avoid glassmorphism on dense data tables or form inputs
Do not use low contrast text on frosted surfaces

screens.name: Auth / OTP
screens.purpose: Secure mobile-number authentication via APITXT OTP verification through backend.

states.loading: Centered verification spinner with brand crimson accent
states.empty: Clean phone number input screen with country code and send OTP button
states.error: Inline error banner with retry option and clear feedback

screens.layout: Editorial full-height single column with Pahel Foundation logo header, warm paper background, large typography for phone input, and sticky bottom action button.

screens.name: Emergency Contact Onboarding
screens.purpose: Mandatory first-time emergency contact setup for safety and SOS dispatch.

states.loading: Saving emergency contact secure state indicator
states.empty: Form fields for contact name, relationship, and phone number with prominent helper text
states.error: Validation error highlight on missing or incorrect phone numbers

screens.layout: Structured form sheet with clear title, input fields, contact picker integration, and sticky primary action button.

screens.name: Permission Onboarding
screens.purpose: Mandatory location and notification permissions setup for emergency response.

states.empty: Illustrated permission cards explaining GPS and push notification importance
states.error: Fallback warning card with direct settings redirect button

screens.layout: Two-step visual card stack with clear icons, descriptive text, and 'Grant Access' buttons.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central hub featuring PAHEL FOUNDATION branding, prominent red SOS, blood requests, active alerts, and quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton card loaders for alerts, blood requests, and active campaigns
states.empty: Welcome banner with emergency readiness checklist and quick start action cards
states.error: Network retry banner with cached status indicator

screens.layout: Scrollable editorial home feed with sticky glass header, prominent circular crimson SOS emergency trigger, quick action grid (Blood, Volunteer, Plans, Donations), active alerts ticker, and recent foundation stories.

screens.name: SOS Emergency Flow
screens.purpose: Immediate emergency distress trigger with GPS acquisition, 50km geospatial search, and emergency contact WhatsApp dispatch.

states.loading: Pulsing red radar animation acquiring live GPS coordinates
states.empty: Press and hold or tap emergency confirmation prompt
states.error: GPS acquisition error banner with manual location entry option

screens.layout: Full-screen high-urgency crimson alert view with countdown confirmation, live map thumbnail, emergency contacts list, and cancellation toggle.

screens.name: Blood Request Flow
screens.purpose: Browse, create, and respond to urgent blood donation requests within 50 KM radius.

states.loading: Loading active blood requests within radius
states.empty: No active requests nearby illustration with 'Post Blood Request' button
states.error: Failed to fetch nearby blood requests with retry button

screens.layout: Tabbed filter view (Nearby Requests / My Requests) with detailed emergency blood cards featuring urgency tags, hospital distance, and instant donor response buttons.

screens.name: Donations & Subscriptions
screens.purpose: Razorpay order creation, secure payment verification, recurring subscription plans, and donation history/receipts.

states.empty: No donation history illustration with featured cause cards
states.error: Payment verification failure message with support contact

screens.layout: Segmented view for One-Time Causes and Monthly Subscriptions with tier cards, secure Razorpay badge, and downloadable receipt ledger.

screens.name: Volunteer & Plans
screens.purpose: Volunteer application form, status tracking, and dynamic foundation support plans.

states.loading: Loading volunteer status and active foundation plans
states.empty: Join Pahel Foundation volunteer network card
states.error: Failed to load profile status with retry button

screens.layout: Editorial cards showcasing volunteer roles, approval status timeline, and dynamic subscription/support plans.

screens.name: Profile & History
screens.purpose: Restricted profile management (name and emergency contact edits) and activity history.

states.error: Failed to update profile data with error toast

screens.layout: Clean profile header with verified badge, editable name & emergency contact fields, activity log, and sign out option.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the React Native Expo mobile app for Pahel Foundation following the 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality combined with iOS-Native clean layout. Ensure the prominent crimson SOS button is instantly accessible on the home dashboard and triggers the 50km geospatial emergency flow. Implement APITXT OTP authentication, mandatory emergency contact & permissions setup, Razorpay donation/subscription integration, blood request dispatch, volunteer application, and restricted profile management. Use expo-image, expo-blur, and react-native-reanimated for smooth native animations. Ensure all touch targets are >= 44x44pt and safe area insets are respected on all screens.
